hero.subtitle: Our goal is to educate and empower parents so they can better understand how to create a long-term healing environment for their children.

approach.title: What is High-Fidelity Wraparound support?
approach.intro: At Love Pathways, true healing doesn’t come from a one-size-fits-all manual. We build a safety net around your family's unique reality.

block1.title: Empowering Your Voice
block1.desc: Our foundation is built entirely on family voice and choice. Your plan is deeply individualized to your specific needs, and completely culturally respectful to your traditions.

block2.title: Building Your Village
block2.desc: We use a strengths-based, team-based model. Professionals work alongside you, but we also integrate natural supports (friends, neighbors) so your care is truly community-based.

block3.title: Relentless Commitment
block3.desc: We are strictly outcomes-based, tracking clear goals. Above all, our promise is persistence: we work alongside you through every challenge until you reach a better place.

gettingStarted.title: How do I get started with Love Pathways Wraparound?
gettingStarted.quote: "We consider it a successful outcome when the family feels empowered."

requestSupport.title: Request Support
requestSupport.desc: Wraparound services can be requested by members of the immediate family.

completeForm.title: Complete Initial Form
completeForm.desc: Once the initial form is completed, a representative will be in touch to discuss the program and explain the requirements.

consultation.title: Personal Consultation
consultation.desc: We'll discuss your specific situation and how our love-based methodology can best support your family.

phases.title: The 4 Phases of Wraparound Care
phases.intro: Following your personal consultation, our High Fidelity Wraparound model kicks in. We use four distinct phases to guide and support your family's journey toward independence.
phases.label: Phase

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.desc: Focused on listening to your story, building trust, and identifying your support team.

planDevelopment.title: Plan Development
planDevelopment.desc: Creating a personalized strategy that reflects your culture and unique strengths.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.desc: Putting the plan into action, tracking progress, and making adjustments with your team.

transition.title: Transition
transition.desc: Preparing for independence by strengthening natural community supports.

reach.description: We've strategically expanded our footprint to ensure that no adoptive family in Northern and Central California has to walk their journey alone.
reach.cardDescription: Our mission is to reach every family in need. If you reside outside these counties, please reach out. We are constantly evaluating new areas for expansion to bring healing where it's needed most.
reach.mapTitle: Map of the 10 California counties served by Love Pathways Wraparound
reach.mapDesc: Love Pathways Wraparound serves families across 10 counties in California. Each served county is filled in and marked with a pin.
